summary: Format conversion of the pinned Dealign CYBERSECURITY NVFP4 checkpoint. Weight-faithful to that checkpoint; no base-model tensors substituted.

architecture.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Dealign CYBERSECURITY)
architecture.type: Mixture-of-experts transformer with linear-attention layers, n-gram per-layer embeddings (PLE) and a multi-token-prediction head

source.derivation: Experts requantized from NVFP4 to searched Q2_0; n-gram table FP8 x scalar to IQ4_NL; dense trunk, MTP and vision from the checkpoint's own BF16 tensors

quantization.label: Searched Q2_0
quantization.experts: Q2_0, per-block scale search (2.25 bits per weight)

memory.note: Inputs to the shared formula in config/runtime-policy.json. Resident model is the main file plus the MTP head; KV and buffers are the runtime's own plan at 131072 tokens and this model's prefill chunk. Routed experts are 48 layers x 512 experts of Q2_0, the same size for every model.

measured.mtp_benefit: about 31 tok/s with MTP against 25 without; output token-identical

evidence.decode: runtime parity run 2026-11-12 (mean of 5 short prompts); bring-up range 32 to 36
evidence.context: production validation 2026-11-12 (59,471 and 120,399-token needle tests at 131072)

quality.name: Context depth
quality.note: Needle answered at 59K and 120K (2026-11-12); prefill 278 tok/s, peak wired 52.94 GiB, 1024-token prefill chunk

override_reasons.prefill_chunk: Metal working set. Cyber's BF16 trunk and F32 projector make its resident footprint 7 GiB larger than Scope's. With the shared 2048-token chunk its 128K plan is 51.92 GiB against the 51.84 GiB recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize, and prefill failed at depth with a Metal out-of-memory error; 1024-token chunks bring the plan to 50.81 GiB and the 120,399-token test passes.

splash-m1-1.6.1-ds1.status: integrated: all seven profiles pass on it (docs/BACKENDS.md); production backend chosen by config/runtime-policy.json

main.source: DwarfStarCyber-Q2_0-main.gguf rewritten as part 1 of Splash's two-part split by scripts/backends/repack_split_gguf.py --link-part2 (tensor payloads and metadata verified identical, no weight changed); part 2 is a link to the unchanged DwarfStarCyber-PLE-IQ4_NL.gguf

vision.source: Cyber's own projector (its BF16 source values in F32, which Splash narrows to BF16 exactly)

cache.policy: Splash's symmetric INT8 KV (per-token-head F32 scales), 32-token pages, prefix cache

memory.note: Splash's own plan for this model (/status): target weights plus the DFlash2 draft (0.49 GiB), INT8 KV at 131072 tokens, prefill/decode/state/pipeline/runtime reserves, BF16 vision. BF16 trunk as the authoritative source stores it, run exactly through BF16 and BF16S planes (patch 0002). Measured peak wired 48.37 GiB (whole machine, backend A/B 2026-11-13).
